raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We're glad to hear about your interest in Cedar Systems' workflow coordination and account reporting capabilities. As requested, we'd be happy to schedule a discovery meeting to better understand your specific integration requirements and how we can support your needs.

Please let us know a convenient time for you, and we'll make the arrangements.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
